description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractBuzzVideoURL' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Buzz\Dto\BuzzVideoURL'. It provides a base for handling Buzz video URLs, including storing the URL and requiring subclasses to implement a method to get an embedded URL. It also uses a trait for text helpers and may throw an 'InvalidURLException'.

classes.name: AbstractBuzzVideoURL
classes.description: An abstract class for Buzz video URL handling, requiring subclasses to implement URL embedding logic, encapsulating the URL property.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URL property.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the stored Buzz video URL.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return an embedded URL string, potentially null, and may throw an InvalidURLException.
